source_of_truth: Operator directive 2026-06-09: build a language-agnostic weak architecture-graph baseline (Plan C0) as a precursor to Plan D, on a 4-tier model (0 inventory / 1 heuristic / 2 parser / 3 build-runtime). On project add, detect languages/package-managers/build-systems/test-frameworks/app-frameworks/docs-ADR/infra and emit a tiered coverage block (overall + per-language + per-evidence-type). Show a filesystem/config graph for ANY repo, with heuristic low-confidence imports for common languages and an explicit low-confidence note for unextracted languages. No UI overhaul; no new parser extractors (that is C+); preserve render-truth.
completion_test: For an arbitrary repo, build_view_state yields a non-empty tier-0 inventory graph + tier-1 heuristic edges (low-confidence/unresolved) + a coverage block (overall rollup, per-language status, per-evidence-type status) with honest ceilings; a Swift/Kotlin fixture shows filesystem/package nodes + missing parser extractor + low dependency confidence (not an empty or confident-fake graph); Python/JS parser-backed coverage is preserved; detector + registry + baseline are pure/deterministic/bounded; verified by fixture-repo tests for Python, JS/TS, and Swift/Kotlin through the real build_view_state surface.

user_journeys.name: weak-graph-any-repo
user_journeys.description: A tracked project in any language gets a useful, truthful architecture baseline immediately.

user_journeys.name: honest-coverage
user_journeys.description: Coverage reports per-language + per-evidence-type with explicit low-confidence notes for unextracted languages.

non_goals: UI overhaul beyond the existing coverage display (Plan D)
New parser-backed extractors for Swift/Kotlin/etc. (Plan C+)
